name: ghs-labels
description: Check a GHS chemical label against its SDS and approved hazard classification under the US OSHA HazCom standard. Build the right pictograms, signal word, hazard and precautionary statements from an approved classification, apply precedence rules, and decide the labeling path for shipped, small, bulk and workplace containers. Works from pasted label text, artwork, SDS sections and classifications; returns a checklist and annotated corrections for the qualified reviewer's sign-off.
